title: Retry build and clean up unused/redundant code and files

requirements.text: Retry the full application build and ensure the project compiles successfully after changes, with no TypeScript build errors and no runtime crashes on initial load.
acceptanceCriteria: `dfx build` (or equivalent project build) completes successfully.
Opening the app shows the Dashboard without a blank screen or crash.

requirements.text: Review the entire codebase and remove unused and redundant files and unnecessary code paths that are not used by the app, while preserving all current app behavior (project creation, layer/trait workshop, rules, preview, vault generation/export, settings, Pinata/IPFS publishing, and localStorage persistence).

quotes: Pls try again and Please review the entire codebase and storage, and remove any unused, redundant files and unnecessary code that are not used by the app.

acceptanceCriteria: No unused modules remain that are not imported/used anywhere in the app (as verified by TypeScript/compiler and a repo-wide search).
Any removed files are also removed from all import sites; the app still runs and core flows still work.
No dead/unused types, exports, or helper functions remain in modules that are still kept.

requirements.text: Perform a targeted cleanup of clearly unused placeholders and legacy scaffolding related to persistence/querying and backend storage, including removing files that are intentionally empty or unused, and trimming backend code that is not referenced by the frontend (while keeping the single-actor backend architecture intact).

quotes: Please review the entire codebase and storage, and remove any unused, redundant files and unnecessary code that are not used by the app.

acceptanceCriteria: Any intentionally-empty placeholder modules (e.g., a hook file that only exports `{}`) are removed if not imported anywhere.
Backend `backend/main.mo` contains only code that is required for the running app; unused type-only declarations are removed if they are not referenced.
After cleanup, there are no broken references in build output (no missing file/module errors).

constraints: Do not edit files under `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, `frontend/src/components/ui` (these paths are immutable).
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo`.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding new product features or changing existing UX/flows beyond what is necessary to remove unused/redundant code.
Introducing new backend services, external databases, or third-party auth providers beyond existing Internet Identity usage.
